title: LAE CCTV TECHNICIAN
description:
Location: Lae, Morobe
CCTV technician - Job Description
CCTV technician is responsible for installing and maintaining closed-circuit television systems. They commonly work with video cameras, monitors, recording devices, networking equipment, and other related hardware to ensure that these systems are functioning properly at all times.
CCTV technician may also be called upon to troubleshoot problems with the system or its components. This might involve anything from replacing broken parts to diagnosing software issues or other technical difficulties.
CCTV Technician Skills Required
Technical skills:
Technical skills are the abilities and knowledge that allow you to perform tasks and complete projects. Technical skills are essential for a CCTV technician as they allow you to install, repair and maintain security systems. Technical skills can include knowledge of electrical systems, computer software and security protocols.
Communication skills:
Communication skills are necessary for a CCTV technician to have, as they must be able to clearly relay information to other technicians, and managers. They must also be able to listen to and understand requests from managers.
Attention to detail:
Attention to detail is the ability to notice small changes in a situation. It’s important for CCTV technicians to notice small changes in a room or area they’ve already inspected. This allows them to identify any new security threats and ensures they’ve thoroughly checked the area.
Problem-solving skills:
Problem-solving skills are essential for CCTV technicians because they often encounter challenges while installing and maintaining security systems. For example, if a camera isn’t working properly, a technician might need to find the source of the problem and fix it. Similarly, if a security system malfunctions, a technician might need to troubleshoot the system and find a solution.
Ability to work independently:
Working independently means that you can complete tasks without the help of others. As a CCTV technician, you may be required to install and repair security systems on your own. This means that you need to have the knowledge and skills necessary to complete the task.
As a CCTV technician at Express Freight Management, you will be responsible for the installation, configuration, and maintenance of our CCTV systems. You will work with our team to ensure that our systems are up-to-date and functioning properly. You may be required to do training or be required to attend training that concerns CCTV systems. You are required to have experience with CCTV systems and networking, as well as a strong understanding of security protocols. You will be required to be detail-oriented and able to work independently.
Duties & Responsibilities
CCTV Roles
Install, maintain, and troubleshoot CCTV systems according to company standards and department specifications.
Perform site surveys to assess department needs and recommend solutions.
Generate system diagrams and documentation for both internal use.
Provide technical support and advice to departments as needed.
Respond to service calls in a timely and professional manner.
Keep up to date with the latest industry developments and technologies.
Maintain and document accurate records of all installed systems.
Always adhere to health and safety guidelines.
Comply with all company policies and procedures.
Installing, maintaining, repairing, and replacing security cameras, computer networks, and other equipment used in video surveillance systems and Information Systems (IT).
Monitoring the operation of security equipment for malfunctions or other problems
Installing and maintaining security equipment such as alarms, access control, or time attendance systems
Structural network cabling and installation
Required Skills and Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent
2+ years experience in installation, maintenance, and repair of CCTV systems
Working knowledge of CCTV equipment, including cameras, DVRs, and monitors
Ability to read and interpret technical manuals and drawings
Basic computer skills, with aptitude to learn new software and systems
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
4+ years experience in installation, maintenance, and repair of CCTV systems
Strong working knowledge of CCTV equipment, including cameras, DVRs, and monitors
Proficient in configuring CCTV systems
Experience developing and implementing CCTV systems
